title: Corporate Financial Policy, Taxation, and Macroeconomic Risk
Internal Net Worth and the Investment Process: An Application to U.S. Agriculture
abstract: Recent models of firm investment decisions stressing informational imperfections in capital markets provide a foundation for interpreting evidence that movements in finance can predict investment opportunities. While such evidence is suggestive, it is often open to other interpretations. We present new evidence in favor of these models that addresses this gap in two ways. First, we focus on the U.S. agricultural sector; the sector has experienced large fluctuations in net worth and the profitability of investment, and reasonable measures of net worth can be constructed. Second, rather than relying on investment function representations (e.g., the q-theory approach), we make use of predictions generated by firms' Euler equation for capital accumulation. Intuitively, during periods in which net worth is high, the Euler equation should hold across adjacent periods; the equation will not hold for periods in which the shadow price of external finance is high because of low net worth. Such an approach offers an alternative model for periods in which net worth is low (holding constant investment opportunities), and generates a link between net worth and investment spending during periods of significant deflation in the value of net worth. Our empirical evidence is presented in three parts. First, the neoclassical, perfect-capital-markets model for investment is rejected by the data. Omitting periods during which there were substantial negative shocks to farmers' net equity positions, the model's overidentifying restrictions can no longer be rejected. Second, allowing for movements in net equity positions contributes importantly to explaining investment. Third, the effect of changes in net worth on investment is significantly more important during the deflationary periods than during boom periods. Taken together, these findings provide support for a class of internal funds models of investment under asymmetric information.
abstract_zh: 近期关于企业投资决策的模型，强调资本市场中的信息不完全，为解释以下证据提供了基础：金融领域的变动能够预测投资机会。尽管这类证据颇具启发性，但它往往容易受到其他解释的影响。我们以两种方式提出了新的证据，以支持这些模型并弥补这一不足。首先，我们聚焦于美国农业部门；该部门经历了净资产和投资盈利能力的大幅波动，而且可以构建合理的净资产衡量指标。其次，我们没有依赖投资函数的表述（例如q理论方法），而是利用了企业资本积累欧拉方程所作出的预测。直观地说，在净资产较高的时期，欧拉方程应当在相邻时期成立；而在净资产较低、外部融资的影子价格较高的时期，该方程则不成立。这种方法为净资产较低时期（保持投资机会不变）提供了一个替代模型，并在净资产价值大幅缩水的通缩时期，建立了净资产与投资支出之间的联系。我们的实证证据分三个部分呈现。首先，数据拒绝了新古典的完全资本市场投资模型。剔除农民净权益遭受重大负向冲击的时期后，该模型的过度识别约束不再被拒绝。其次，考虑净权益头寸的变动，对解释投资有重要贡献。第三，在通缩时期，净资产变化对投资的影响显著大于繁荣时期。综合来看，这些发现为信息不对称条件下一类内部资金投资模型提供了支持。

Contracting and Price Adjustment in Commodity Markets: Evidence from Copper and Oil
abstract: This paper analyzes price adjustment in markets where trade takes place through both spot-market and long-term-contract transactions. The authors develop a model illustrating the role of the resulting two-price system in describing price adjustment to transitory shocks; persistence effects of these shocks on prices depends on, inter alia, the fraction of trades carried out through contracts. The model is tested on price data from the world copper and crude oil markets. Econometric tests of the model provide support for the hypothesis that the increase in the importance of spot markets in copper and oil is associated with an increase in the speed of adjustment of spot prices to supply and demand disturbances. abstract_zh: 本文分析了在既通过现货市场交易、又通过长期合同交易的市场中的价格调整。作者构建了一个模型，说明由此产生的双价格体系在描述价格对暂时性冲击的调整中所起的作用；这些冲击对价格的持续性效应，尤其取决于通过合同进行交易的比例。该模型在世界铜和原油市场的价格数据上进行了检验。对模型的计量检验支持如下假设：铜和石油市场中现货市场重要性的上升，与现货价格对供需扰动的调整速度加快相关。版权所有 1989 麻省理工学院出版社。

abstract: Much of the rapid increases in the price of crude oil during two of the last three supply shocks has been attributed to increased private inventory demand stimulated by the expectation of speculative profits. Government intervention in any future disruption is likely to take the form of releases from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR). Given that the SPR accounts for but a small fraction of U.S. oil inventories, the reaction of the private sector is critical in evaluating its impact. We incorporate inventory behavior in a model of the world oil market, which is then linked to a short-run macroeconometric model of the U.S. economy. Our model simulations support the view that substantial inventory accumulation accompanies a supply disruption. In the debate over whether the SPR is potentially a potent or impotent resource in an emergency, we lean toward potency. Our model suggests that public releases will not be absorbed in private stockpiles; indeed, their dampening price effects will serve, albeit slightly, to discourage speculative stock build.
abstract_zh: 在最近三次供给冲击中的两次，原油价格的快速上涨，很大程度上被归因于出于投机利润预期而刺激的私人库存需求增加。政府在未来任何供应中断中的干预，很可能采取从战略石油储备（SPR）释放石油的形式。鉴于战略石油储备仅占美国石油库存的一小部分，私人部门的反应对于评估其影响至关重要。我们将库存行为纳入世界石油市场模型，并将该模型与美国经济的一个短期宏观计量模型相连接。我们的模型模拟支持如下观点：供应中断伴随着大量的库存积累。在关于战略石油储备在紧急情况下是有力还是无力资源的争论中，我们倾向于认为其有力。我们的模型表明，公共释放的石油不会被私人储备所吸收；事实上，其对价格的抑制作用将略微阻止投机性囤货的增加。

title: Regulation and Long-Term Contracts in U.S. Natural Gas Markets
Supply Shocks and Price Adjustment in the World Oil Market
abstract: Understanding the impacts of transitory oil supply shocks on world oil prices is crucial to the evaluation of the economic impacts of shocks and the design of policy responses to address those impacts. This paper integrates short-run and long-run approaches to oil price determination, with particular emphasis on the “two-price” structure of the world oil market—with coexisting short-term “spot” prices and long-term “contract” prices. Even transitory shocks are shown to exhibit persistence effects on long-term prices. Some implications for econometric models of the relationship between spot and contract prices are discussed.
abstract_zh: 理解暂时性石油供给冲击对世界油价的影响，对于评估冲击的经济影响以及设计应对政策至关重要。本文整合了石油价格决定的短期与长期方法，特别强调世界石油市场的“双价格”结构，即短期“现货”价格与长期“合同”价格并存。研究表明，即使是暂时性冲击，也会对长期价格产生持续性效应。文中还讨论了这一现象对现货价格与合同价格之间关系的计量模型所具有的一些含义。

title: The Farm Debt Crisis and Public Policy
abstract: U.S. farms, and with them agricultural lending institutions, are currently experiencing their most severe stress since the 1930s. From 1980 to 1984, the average real value of the U.S. farmland dropped by 29 percent. The decline has been most pronounced in the Corn Belt and the Northern Plains states that produce cash grains, general livestock, and dairy products; in Nebraska, for example, the real value of farmland is half what is was in 1980. The erosion in the value of equity has had the effect of increasing the leverage of many farm borrowers. Delinquent loans have increased substantially hitting 7.5 percent of total loans at small agricultural banks by mid-1985.
abstract_zh: 美国农场及与之相关的农业贷款机构，目前正经历自20世纪30年代以来最严重的压力。1980至1984年间，美国农田的平均实际价值下降了29%。这一下跌在生产谷物、一般畜牧业和乳制品的玉米带与北部平原各州最为明显；例如在内布拉斯加州，农田的实际价值仅为1980年的一半。股权价值的侵蚀使许多农业借款人的杠杆率上升。到1985年年中，逾期贷款大幅增加，在小型农业银行的贷款总额中占比达到7.5%。
